Name: Simple Farm Manager(SFM)
Author: slpOff
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[b]Simple Farm Manager[/b] is a lightweight framework for Stardew Valley that lets farm creators customize the starting state of their farms without writing C# code.
By adding a farm.json file to your mod and declaring a dependency on Simple Farm Manager, you can automatically configure a farm when a new save is created.

Supported features include:
[list]
[*]Starting buildings (Coops, Barns, Sheds, etc.) [/*]
[*]Starting animals inside buildings [/*]
[*]Starting objects and machines [/*]
[*]Terrain features such as trees, fruit trees, and grass [/*]
[*]Support for vanilla and custom farm types [/*]
[/list]Simple Farm Manager handles all placement logic internally, including obstacle removal, collision checks, building placement, animal assignment, and one-time application.
Create farm presets with a simple JSON file and focus on designing your farm instead of writing setup code.

[b]Think of it as a starting farm configuration framework inspired by Farm Type Manager, but focused on buildings, animals, and farm layouts instead of map spawns.[/b]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]1. Install SMAPI latest version.[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]2. [/color][color=#d4d4d8]Extract the downloaded file and place it in your Mods folder.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
Simple Farm Manager is a framework for creating custom starting farm layouts.
Farm creators can define buildings, animals, objects, and terrain features through a simple farm.json file. When a new game starts, the framework automatically applies the configured layout to supported farm types.
Just add a dependency and create your farm preset. No C# setup code required.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]- SMAPI latest version[/color]
